claims.text: KV offload WITHOUT prefix caching is impossible on this model: enabling the offloading connector (128 GiB) with prefix caching disabled crashes EngineCore at init — AssertionError 'gpu_block_size=262144 not divisible by hash_block_size=13369344. Hybrid models (e.g. Mamba+Attention) need --enable-prefix-caching to align block sizes.' The service crash-looped until I restored the hook (recovered automatically after restore, 42.2s).

KV offload WITH prefix caching (experiment 5b: keep --enable-prefix-caching + mamba align + 128 GiB offload) WORKS on this model, overturning the standing 'no KV reuse is possible' premise: engine initialized; 136 GB of DDR5 allocated as pinned CPU KV pool (free -g 21->163 GB used); identical 50k-token prompt TTFT 11.01s -> 1.03s (10.7x); prefix_cache_hits 0 -> 48,960 tokens; 1,864,433,664 bytes physically transferred GPU->CPU in 65ms (~28.7 GB/s); kv_offload metrics live.

Cost of 5b measured: GPU KV pool 1,436,030 -> 1,374,484 tokens (-4.3%); short-prompt decode unchanged (132.201 tok/s vs 131.4-131.6 baseline; output digest byte-identical 95f9d0...8af9, so the standard correctness gate passed); cold start 143.6s vs ~47s warm baseline; 136 GB host RAM committed.

Production was restored to the qualified profile after the experiments and confirmed: hook byte-identical to backup (cmp exit 0), 131.383 tok/s mean (stdev 0.02), same digest, RAM back to 25 GB used. The 5b configuration is presented as a CANDIDATE, not promoted — promoting it is an architecture decision above this arm's ceiling.

Dragonfly tensor-serving and zero-copy research docs (read: section maps + architecture sections) target 2-4 GB expert-weight tensor serving for the moe-precognition/eBPF-MoE stack — a different DDR5 consumer that requires standing up that serving stack; not implementable inside the qwen27-mtp lane this session. No number is claimed for it.

decisions_requested.decision: Promote-or-not the 5b profile (prefix caching + mamba align + CPU KV offload) for long-context workloads. Measured gains: 10.7x TTFT on repeated long prefixes, 136 GB DDR5 in use, no short-prompt regression, digest-identical output on the standard gate. Measured costs: -4.3% GPU KV pool, ~100s slower cold start, 136 GB RAM commitment, and vLLM labels the offload API experimental. Interacts directly with the 1M YaRN decision (same workloads). This arm recommends qualifying 5b behind the same semantic-gate battery used for FP8 before any promotion.

risks: vLLM marks OffloadingSpec experimental; mamba-align prefix cache was previously disabled as 'experimental' by the tuning session — one digest-identical standard-workload gate is necessary but not sufficient for long-context correctness.
My crash-loop window (23:53-23:59 ADT) put ~8 failed starts on the service; any consumer during that window saw refused connections.
